stories.title: Jeffries wins Democratic nomination for House speaker, paving way for historic election
stories.summary: Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries easily won his party's nomination for the next speaker of the House on Wednesday.

stories.title: Judge to release some Ilhan Omar search warrant records, but keep affidavit sealed
stories.summary: A federal judge sided with the Justice Department on keeping most of a 67-page affidavit under seal, but said other filings tied to the Oct. 12 search of the Minnesota Democrat's Washington home could be public as soon as Monday.

stories.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 is ready to roll. "Visually, it's incredible," one player said.
stories.summary: The latest, long-awaited version of the hit video game franchise launches at midnight local time on Nov. 19 in countries worldwide. Here's what to know about GTA 6.

stories.title: Waterford motorcyclist injured after being struck by SUV in Bloomfield Township, police say
stories.summary: A motorcyclist from Waterford was injured after an SUV struck them in Bloomfield Township, police say.

stories.title: White House drops Trump's FDA pick
stories.summary: The White House has withdrawn the nomination of Dr. Heidi Overton, President Trump's pick for Food and Drug Administration commissioner, according to a senior administration official and others close to the matter.

stories.title: Families of 67 victims of midair crash push for safer skies
stories.summary: The family members of the victims of a midair crash in 2025 on American Airlines flight 5342 are trying to pass safety legislation.

stories.title: Worker injured in explosion at hazardous waste facility in Texas
stories.summary: A worker was hurt in an explosion at a hazardous waste facility near Houston, Texas, on Tuesday night. The worker is now reported to be in stable condition.

stories.title: Thanksgiving meal costs down, wine prices up
stories.summary: The price of Thanksgiving meals could be lower this year. On the other hand, wine prices are higher. Experts say it's because the cost of importing wine has soared.

stories.title: Costco sees surge in panic buying after string of tech outages, report says
stories.summary: Costco shoppers are stocking up on emergency items following a string of tech snafus, according to a Wall Street analyst.

stories.title: Pedestrian killed after getting hit by vehicle in Roseville, police say
stories.summary: A pedestrian was killed after getting hit by a vehicle in Roseville Wednesday morning, police say.

stories.title: What to know about Detroit's tree lighting
stories.summary: This year's tree lighting ceremony is happening on Friday in Downtown Detroit. The City of Detroit expects thousands of people to attend.
